sentences.text: Pachyosteus belongs to the family Selenosteidae within the clade Aspinothoracidi, which is part of the larger clade Pachyosteomorphi.
The genus was described by Jaekel in 1903.
The type species of the genus is Pachyosteus bulla, also described by Jaekel in 1903.
According to Rücklin (2011), Pachyosteus bulla is a basal selenosteid and the sister taxon to American genera.
This fish lived during the Frasnian stage, approximately 379 to 375.2 million years ago.
Fossils are found in the Late Devonian Kellwasserkalk facies of Bad Wildungen, Germany, and the Famennian layers of the Holy Cross Mountains in Poland.
